title: Using AI To Detect AI Music (and other music industry data-porn)
summary: Musician Benn Jordan uses AI to detect AI-generated music and digs into music industry data, including streaming payouts and sample library copyright problems. He covers ways to tell whether a track is human-made.
why: HN recommends it in threads on AI music flooding streaming platforms, for its practical detection ideas such as compression artifacts.

quote.text: has a great video about using AI to detect AI music. It's worth a watch.
